HOS.P.6.1-11.text: The Unrepentance of Israel and Judah

HOS.P.11.1-7.text: Out of Egypt I Called My Son

HOS.P.12.1-14.text: A Reproof of Ephraim, Judah, and Jacob

HOS.1.1-2.text: The LORD tells Hosea to marry a prostitute

HOS.1.3-5.text: Hosea and Gomer have a son named Jezreel

HOS.1.6-7.text: Gomer’s daughter Lo-ruhamah: God will save only Judah

HOS.1.8-9.text: Gomer has a son named Lo-ammi, not my people

HOS.1.10-11.text: God promises that Israel will become many and united

HOS.2.1-1.text: Israel’s brothers and sisters are called God’s people

HOS.2.2-3.text: God warns unfaithful Israel, like a wife, of punishment

HOS.2.4-5.text: God will not pity the children of the unfaithful mother

HOS.2.6-7.text: God will block Israel from chasing false gods

HOS.2.8-9.text: God will take back the gifts Israel used for Baal

HOS.2.10-11.text: God will end Israel’s feasts and expose her sin

HOS.2.12-13.text: God will punish Israel for worshiping Baals

HOS.2.14-15.text: God will win Israel back in the wilderness

HOS.2.16-17.text: Israel will call God her Husband, not Master

HOS.2.18-18.text: God will make a covenant and bring peace and safety

HOS.2.19-20.text: God promises to marry Israel forever in faithfulness

HOS.2.21-22.text: God will bless the land with grain, wine and oil

HOS.2.23-23.text: God will show mercy and call Israel his people

HOS.3.1-3.text: Hosea loves his wife again and buys her back

HOS.3.4-5.text: Israel will be without a king, then return to the LORD

HOS.4.1-2.text: The LORD accuses Israel of lying, murder and stealing

HOS.4.3-3.text: The land mourns and living things waste away

HOS.4.4-5.text: God warns that priest and prophet will stumble

HOS.4.6-7.text: God’s people are destroyed for lack of knowledge

HOS.4.8-9.text: God will punish both priests and people for sin

HOS.4.10-10.text: Israel will eat but not be satisfied

HOS.4.11-12.text: Wine and idols take away Israel’s understanding

HOS.4.13-14.text: Israel’s idol worship and prostitution bring ruin

HOS.4.15-16.text: God warns Judah not to follow Israel’s sin

HOS.4.17-19.text: Ephraim is joined to idols and will be ashamed

HOS.5.1-2.text: God judges the priests and royal house of Israel

HOS.5.3-4.text: God knows Ephraim has turned to prostitution

HOS.5.5-7.text: Israel and Judah stumble and cannot find the LORD

HOS.5.8-9.text: A trumpet warns that Ephraim will be laid waste

HOS.5.10-11.text: God’s anger falls on Judah’s princes and on Ephraim

HOS.5.12-13.text: Ephraim and Judah turn to Assyria, which cannot heal

HOS.5.14-15.text: God will punish Ephraim and Judah like a lion

HOS.6.1-3.text: The people urge each other to return to the LORD

HOS.6.4-5.text: Loyalty of Ephraim and Judah is like morning mist

HOS.6.6-7.text: God wants mercy, not sacrifice, from Israel

HOS.6.8-9.text: Gilead’s evildoers and priests commit murder

HOS.6.10-11.text: God sees Israel’s sin and promises a harvest for Judah

HOS.7.1-2.text: God will expose the evil of Ephraim and Samaria

HOS.7.3-5.text: Israel’s leaders please the king with evil and lies

HOS.7.6-7.text: Israel’s kings fall and no one calls on God

HOS.7.8-9.text: Ephraim mixes with the nations and loses strength

HOS.7.10-11.text: Ephraim seeks help from Egypt and Assyria, not God

HOS.7.12-13.text: God will punish Israel for straying and lying

HOS.7.14-15.text: Israel does not cry to God from the heart

HOS.7.16-16.text: Israel is like a faulty bow and leaders will fall

HOS.8.1-3.text: An enemy will attack because Israel broke God’s covenant

HOS.8.4-5.text: Israel chose its own kings and made idols

HOS.8.6-7.text: Samaria’s calf idol will break; Israel reaps a whirlwind

HOS.8.8-10.text: Israel pays Assyria for help and will be punished

HOS.8.11-12.text: Ephraim builds altars for sin and ignores God’s law

HOS.8.13-14.text: God rejects Israel’s sacrifices and will send fire

HOS.9.1-2.text: God warns Israel not to rejoice after being unfaithful

HOS.9.3-4.text: Israel will leave the land for Egypt and Assyria

HOS.9.5-6.text: Israel’s people will die in Egypt and thorns will grow

HOS.9.7-7.text: The days of punishment come because of Israel’s sin

HOS.9.8-9.text: Israel is as corrupt as in the days of Gibeah

HOS.9.10-10.text: God found Israel like grapes, but Israel worshiped Baal-peor

HOS.9.11-12.text: God will take away Ephraim’s children and glory

HOS.9.13-14.text: Ephraim’s children will be killed and wombs will fail

HOS.9.15-15.text: God will drive Israel out because of evil at Gilgal

HOS.9.16-17.text: God rejects Ephraim, who will wander among the nations

HOS.10.1-2.text: God will destroy the altars Israel built in good times

HOS.10.3-4.text: Israel says it has no king and makes false oaths

HOS.10.5-6.text: Samaria’s people will mourn when the calf idol is taken

HOS.10.7-8.text: Samaria and her king will be swept away

HOS.10.9-9.text: Israel has sinned since the days of Gibeah

HOS.10.10-11.text: God will bring nations to punish Israel’s double sin

HOS.10.12-13.text: Israel is told to sow righteousness and seek the LORD

HOS.10.14-15.text: War will destroy Israel’s fortresses and end its king

HOS.11.1-2.text: God loved Israel as a child, but Israel turned to Baals

HOS.11.3-4.text: God taught Ephraim to walk and led Ephraim with love

HOS.11.5-7.text: Israel refused to repent, so Assyria will rule Israel

HOS.11.8-9.text: God’s compassion keeps him from destroying Israel

HOS.11.10-11.text: God will bring his children home from Egypt and Assyria

HOS.11.12-12.text: Ephraim is full of lies, but Judah stays faithful to God

HOS.12.1-2.text: Ephraim makes treaties, and God accuses Judah

HOS.12.3-4.text: Jacob struggled with God and found him at Bethel

HOS.12.5-6.text: Israel must return to God and keep love and justice

HOS.12.7-8.text: Ephraim boasts of wealth and cheats with false scales

HOS.12.9-10.text: God spoke to Israel through the prophets

HOS.12.11-12.text: God will turn the altars of Gilgal into heaps of stones

HOS.12.13-14.text: God brought Israel out by a prophet; Ephraim angered God

HOS.13.1-2.text: Ephraim sinned with Baal and made idols of silver

HOS.13.3-3.text: Israel will vanish like mist, dew, chaff and smoke

HOS.13.4-6.text: God is the only Savior, but Israel forgot God

HOS.13.7-8.text: God will attack Israel like a lion, leopard and bear

HOS.13.9-11.text: Israel is destroyed because Israel turned against God

HOS.13.12-13.text: Ephraim’s sin is stored up, and Ephraim is unwise

HOS.13.14-14.text: God speaks of redeeming Israel from death and Sheol

HOS.13.15-15.text: A wind from the LORD will dry up Israel’s springs

HOS.13.16-16.text: Samaria will fall by the sword for rebelling against God

HOS.14.1-2.text: Israel is called to return to the LORD and pray

HOS.14.3-3.text: Israel promises to trust God, not Assyria or idols

HOS.14.4-6.text: God promises to heal and love Israel freely

HOS.14.7-8.text: Israel will grow again, and God will care for Ephraim

HOS.14.9-9.text: The wise understand that the LORD’s ways are right
